evidence.note: Authentication record sets OAuth with StartLogin, FinishLogin and Refresh. No anonymous, key or other auth kind.
Generates a code verifier and S256 code_challenge (lines 856-862), so the authorization request uses PKCE.
Refresh handler posts a refresh_token grant through TokenMethod (lines 885-910).
All data and metadata calls go through Web.Contents (line 791).
Token exchange also uses Web.Contents (line 895).
OneStreamURL is the environment URL the user supplies (url-or-server).
Selected Application is a user-supplied resource name inside the environment (database-or-resource-id).
Application and Cube are user-supplied resource names (database-or-resource-id).
Workspace Name and Adapter Name are resource names (database-or-resource-id).
SessionInfoBody, Scenario, Time and the other cube filter parameters are passed as their own text parameters, covered by other.
ResultDataTableName and CustomSubstVarsAsCommaSeparatedPairs are passed straight through as query text, covered by other.
Pages are built with List.Numbers and Table.AddColumn, requesting each page by a page number (page query param, line 765). This is not offset-limit, Table.GenerateByPage, List.Generate or recursion.
Decides between single-page and multi-page retrieval based on TotalPages.
Page list generated with List.Numbers(1, count, 1) and mapped with Table.AddColumn; no Table.GenerateByPage, List.Generate or self-recursive paging.

paging-stop.text: Paging stops once the pages reported by the first response's TotalPages field have been requested: LoopAndGetData fetches pages 1 through TotalPages (List.Numbers(1, count, 1)).

evidence.note: TotalPages from the first result sets the count; the loop ends after that many pages.
Response body parsed with Json.Document; this carries the returned data (DataResult rows).
Table.TransformColumnTypes assigns hardcoded M types (text, datetime, number) to named columns of the returned table (declared-schema and explicit-type-conversion).
Column names come from the data (Record.ToTable(Column1)[Name]) with no declared M types, used for metadata and data adapter tables.
Declared columns are applied by ExpandRecordColumn and TransformColumnTypes, but the code does not show how an empty list behaves at runtime.
table{0} fails on an empty table, so the metadata and adapter tables cannot be confirmed to keep columns when empty.
Every data request sets ManualStatusHandling = {500,400}, so no call relies on default Power Query status handling.
Token calls also set ManualStatusHandling = {401,403} and inspect the response.
HTTP 500 and 400 responses are turned into Error.Record values (Invalid Request, Error).
Token error responses are raised as Error.Record values.
Documentation.Name and Documentation.LongDescription on shared functions (function-documentation).
Documentation.FieldCaption, FieldDescription and SampleValues on parameters (parameter-captions, parameter-descriptions, sample-values).
Authorized applications are listed at runtime from the logon response, so the navigator is discovered from the API.
Cube folder rows use IsLeaf false (line 416), so navigation rows open further navigation tables (hierarchical).
Hardcoded function rows inside the discovered tree do not count as fixed-list.
TestConnection = (dataSourcePath) => {"OneStream.Navigation", dataSourcePath} names the shared entry function, OneStream.Navigation.
The connector is a single .pq file with no pqm modules or LoadFunction helpers (single-file).
Label uses Extension.LoadString("DataSourceLabel") (localized-strings).
ButtonText uses Extension.LoadString (localized-strings).
Icon16 and Icon32 are loaded with Extension.Contents (icons).
Analytics data-request job (RequestId) is polled with GetDataRequest until it completes. This is a data job, not an export.

polling-rule.text: The first poll waits FirstRetryInterval = 5 s (line 768), and later polls wait RetryInterval = 10 s (line 779). The timeout is RequestTimeOut = 1800 s, converted to a retry count of 1800/10 (line 759). The terminal state is Status = "Completed" (lines 769 and 706). On exhaustion, it raises an Error.Record with code Timeout (line 779).

evidence.note: Polling interval, timeout and completion checks.
Constants: timeout 1800, first retry 5, retry interval 10.
